facts: About 3.5 million people (2025) in the city proper
About 660 m above sea level, on the River Manzanares
worth_knowing: It began as a walled military outpost in the late 9th century and became the permanent seat of the court in 1561. It is the second-largest city in the European Union, after Berlin.
